name: Example: specificity cross-docking (colchicine site)
title: Reference specificity matrix -- colchicine-site ligand versus actin-binding natural products on tubulin
description: Second EXAMPLE campaign. It shows what the pair's `control` block is for: colchicine in the colchicine site of tubulin is the POSITIVE arm and must reproduce the pose from co-crystal 1SA0, while the natural products that bind actin rather than tubulin are the NEGATIVE arms. Without both arms, 'weak affinity' is indistinguishable from 'the control worked'.
